about: Real Fix Factory answers to GET /api/runs/<id> from the pull request line, recorded 2026-10-26 on the factory's test repo (factory/tests/split_repo): one fix across shop/, worker/ and terraform/. The agent is the scripted stand-in from factory/tests/test_pipeline.py and GitHub is the stand-in in factory/tests/fake_github.py, so the pull request links point at github.example. opened: three pull requests open, CI passed on each. merged: the same run after all three were merged. ci_failed: a second run whose CI on pull request #2 was made to fail.

item.title: Errors are not logged with a request id

opened.diff:
diff --git a/shop/orders.py b/shop/orders.py
index 2f318aa..f8a4242 100644
--- a/shop/orders.py
+++ b/shop/orders.py
@@ -9,4 +9,5 @@ def place_order(request_id: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
     try:
         return {"ok": True, "total": payload["qty"] * payload["price"]}
     except KeyError:
+        log.error("order refused request_id=%s", request_id)
         return {"ok": False}

index b62261b..98e609c 100644
--- a/worker/jobs.py
+++ b/worker/jobs.py

     try:
         return job["amount"] > 0
     except KeyError:
+        log.error("job refused request_id=%s", request_id)
         return False
